paragraphs.text: Kamigawa: Titanbreach is the 118 Magic expansion, currently scheduled for release on June 4, 2027. It is a " mechs versus monsters " set showcasing an interplanar conflict between Kamigawa and Ikoria , facilitated by a large omenpath .
Ikoria had been considered as a plane for the travelogue set Aetherdrift , but that idea was abandoned when the idea for Titanbreach came up.

Titanbreach revisits the monster movie and Kaiju tropes from Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths and its associated Godzilla Series Monster cards . Kaiju is a Japanese genre of films featuring giant monsters like Godzilla , often facing off with Mecha , gigantic robots or machines, which are categorised as Kyodai Hero works. Compared to the Ikoria set, the size of the monsters is upped.

A giant omenpath poses an existential threat to the people of Kamigawa . The sky opens up and out falls Ikoria . Giant monsters, weird creatures, nightmares , elementals and literally the land itself fall out of the sky. Crystals appear everywhere. The story explores how the people of Kamigawa deal with this incursion. How they are going to defend their homes and themselves, and how the magic of the plane is affected.
